hypothesis: Completing one Jungle emblem in the unchanged chosen stat, and applying its camp mitigation to recovery estimates, increases matched development win rate over the edit base. Unchanged or lower win rate falsifies the prediction.
basis: Unmeasured rules/source deduction: the first emblem exchanges one Power growth point for 30% less camp damage. Longer healthy farming sorties can improve objective throughput even without reducing deaths. Final statistics do not identify recovery turns or establish causality.

policy.shopping: At the existing spawn-only shop, finish one Jungle emblem in the existing randomly selected stat, using SDK cost/combine metadata and bounded purchases. Reobserve completion before buying remaining Power shards. No extra shopping location, recall, stat or draft changes.
policy.recovery: Only completed Jungle emblems activate the 0.70 camp-strength factor. Champion threat damage remains unchanged. Existing 35% floor, 70% scan threshold, two-volley reserve, caps, fuel reserves, visibility, channels and escape policy remain.

expected_observable: Higher matched development win rate; collection/tribute, camp damage taken and recovery travel/turns where available diagnose mechanism.
risk: Loses one selected-stat growth point relative to the first Power emblem; benefit is small on harmless cluster routes. Changed timing and less conservative camp estimates may worsen hidden-threat encounters. Branch coverage and headroom are unmeasured.
negative_findings: Latest gem-priority trial regressed by 4/112 development games. Earlier broad fixed-draft/Jungle+Monster/capture rewrite ce955542 was inconclusive and not selected. This trial preserves random draft/stat, uses only one family, and couples known protection to the current recovery model. Prior route, dash, teleport, shopping recall, capture, banking, focus-fire and AoE trials are not reapplied.
